_about: Bitcraze Crazyflie 2.1+ (brushed, 27 g). The sim's default drone.
_source: cf2x.urdf in utiasDSL/gym-pybullet-drones (Forster 2015, Landry 2015, Luis & Le Ny 2016); downwash coefficients from gym-pybullet-drones BaseAviary
_units: SI: kg, m, kg*m^2, N/RPM^2, N*m/RPM^2, s; drag and ground-effect coefficients as in the URDF
_source_deploy: radio interface numbers (firmware_*, hover_thrust_command, thrust_command_*, motor_volts_to_thrust_*, low_battery_v): bitcraze/crazyflie-firmware motors.c + platform_defaults_cf2.h (2.1+ propellers), cflib Commander.send_setpoint docs
_calibrate: hover_thrust_command is computed from mass_kg; measure it on the real drone with python -m mindflight.deploy --calibrate-hover
name: crazyflie_2_1_plus
